$comment: The machine-readable command manifest of ks. One row per verb the binary dispatches; manifest_test.go fails the build if this file and the source disagree in either direction. Downstream (keepstate.ai/docs/cli and its verb-count lint) renders FROM this file and must never hand-type a verb. Rows may carry `safety` (a refusal the product makes on the customer's behalf, which the docs page renders as the safety property it is) and `budgetDefaults` (the per-tier session token budget). Both are DESCRIPTIONS OF MEASURED OR SOURCED BEHAVIOUR, and manifest_test.go fails if a row states one without saying where the number came from. A two-word verb (`cruise init`) is a subcommand: the first word is the case arm in main.go, the second the case arm in cruise.go's runCruise; both directions are checked. Rows may carry `flags`, one entry per flag with its one-line meaning.
